paragraphs: Allow team members to review designs as their work schedule allows.
This in turn results in the following benefits:
Higher Participation & Accessibility. They do not need to be online and available at the same time as others to review.
Reduced Time Constraint. Reviewers can spend longer than the duration of a single meeting to think through the approach and provide feedback.
The metrics and/or KPIs used for design reviews overall would still apply. See design reviews for measures guidance.
The participation should be same as any design review. See design reviews for participation guidance.

The concept is to have the design follow the same workflow as any code changes to implement story or task. Rather than code however, the artifacts being added or changed are Markdown documents as well as any other supporting artifacts (prototypes, code samples, diagrams, etc).
Design documentation must live in a source control repository that supports pull requests (i.e. git). The following guidelines can be used to determine what repository houses the docs
Keeping docs in the same repo as the affected code allows for the docs to be updated atomically alongside code within the same pull request.
translations: 允许团队成员根据他们的工作安排来审查设计。
参与度和可参与性更高：评审者不必与其他人同时在线，也能查看设计并提出意见。
减少时间限制。审查者可以花费比单次会议更长的时间来思考方法并提供反馈。
用于整体设计审查的指标和/或KPI仍然适用。请参阅设计审查的衡量指标指南。
参与度应与任何设计审查相同。请参阅设计审查的参与指南。
设计文档可以沿用实现用户故事或任务时的代码变更流程。不同之处在于，提交或修改的是 Markdown 文档，以及原型、代码示例、图表等支持材料。
设计文档应放在支持拉取请求（例如 Git）的版本控制仓库中。以下指南可以帮助判断文档应存放在哪个仓库。
将文档与相关代码放在同一仓库，可以在同一个拉取请求中同步更新文档和代码。
fullTextParagraphs: Allow team members to review designs as their work schedule allows.
This in turn results in the following benefits:
Higher Participation & Accessibility. They do not need to be online and available at the same time as others to review.
Reduced Time Constraint. Reviewers can spend longer than the duration of a single meeting to think through the approach and provide feedback.
The metrics and/or KPIs used for design reviews overall would still apply. See design reviews for measures guidance.
The participation should be same as any design review. See design reviews for participation guidance.

The concept is to have the design follow the same workflow as any code changes to implement story or task. Rather than code however, the artifacts being added or changed are Markdown documents as well as any other supporting artifacts (prototypes, code samples, diagrams, etc).
Design documentation must live in a source control repository that supports pull requests (i.e. git). The following guidelines can be used to determine what repository houses the docs
Keeping docs in the same repo as the affected code allows for the docs to be updated atomically alongside code within the same pull request.
If the documentation represents code that lives in many different repositories, it may make more sense to keep the docs in their own repository.

Place the docs so that they do not trigger CI builds for the affected code (assuming the documentation was the only change). This can be done by placing them in an isolated directory should they live alongside the code they represent. See directory structure example below.
The designer branches the repo with the documentation.
The designer works on adding or updating documentation relevant to the design.
The designer submits pull request and requests specific team members to review.
Reviewers provide feedback to Designer who incorporates the feedback.
(OPTIONAL) Design review meeting might be held to give deeper explanation of design to reviewers.
Design is approved/accepted and merged to main branch.

To make sure a design is reviewed in a timely manner, it's important to directly request reviews from team members. If team members are assigned without asking, or if no one is assigned it's likely the design will sit for longer without review. Try the following actions:
Make it the designer's responsibility to find reviewers for their design
The designer should ask a team member directly (face-to-face conversation, async messaging, etc) if they are available to review. Only if they agree, then assign them as a reviewer.
Indicate if the design is ready to be merged once approved.

It helps the reviewer to understand if the design is ready to be accepted or if its still a work-in-progress. The level and type of feedback the reviewer provides will likely be different depending on its state. Try the following actions to indicate the design state
Mark the PR as a Draft. Some ALM tools support opening a pull request as a Draft such as Azure DevOps.
Prefix the title with "DRAFT", "WIP", or "work-in-progress".
Set the pull request to automatically merge after approvals and checks have passed. This can indicate to the reviewer the design is complete from the designer's perspective.

The designated reviewers are not the only team members that can provide feedback on the design. If other team members voluntarily committed time to providing feedback or asking questions, be sure to respond. Utilize face-to-face conversation (in person or virtual) to resolve feedback or questions from others as needed. This aids in building team cohesiveness in ensuring everyone understands and is willing to commit to a given design. This practice demonstrates inclusive behavior; which will promote trust and respect within the team.
Respond to all PR comments objectively and respectively irrespective of the authors level, position, or title.
After two round trips of question/response, resort to synchronous communication for resolution (i.e. virtual or physical face-to-face conversation).

notes.phrase: Allow team members to review designs as their work schedule allows
notes.meaning: 允许团队成员根据自己的工作安排来评审设计
notes.explain: 这种做法体现了灵活性和尊重个人工作节奏的管理理念
notes.example: Our company allows team members to review documents as their work schedule allows, promoting better work-life balance.

notes.meaning: 更高的参与度和可访问性
notes.explain: 异步评审消除了时间同步的障碍，使更多人能够参与
notes.example: The asynchronous meeting format resulted in higher participation & accessibility for our global team members across different time zones.

notes.explain: 评审者可以不受会议时长限制，有更充分的时间思考
notes.example: The reduced time constraint in our review process allows for more thorough feedback without rushing through comments.

notes.phrase: design follow the same workflow as any code changes
notes.meaning: 设计遵循与代码更改相同的工作流程
notes.explain: 将设计文档纳入版本控制系统，采用类似代码变更的管理方式
notes.example: At our firm, we ensure that design documentation follows the same workflow as any code changes to maintain consistency in our development process.

scenario.title: Asynchronous Design Review Process
english: Sarah, a UX designer, needs feedback on her new dashboard design from the development team before proceeding with implementation.
The development team is currently overwhelmed with a critical bug fix deadline, making it difficult to schedule a synchronous meeting for design review.
Sarah proposes: 'Could everyone review the design documents by Friday and add comments directly in Figma? This way, we can proceed without waiting for a meeting.'
chinese: UX设计师Sarah需要在推进实施前，从开发团队获取新仪表板设计的反馈。
开发团队目前正忙于修复关键bug的截止日期，难以安排同步会议进行设计评审。
Sarah提出：'大家能否在周五前查看设计文档并在Figma中直接添加评论？这样我们就可以无需等待会议直接推进。'

firstAttempt.prompt: 设计方案需要多个时区的同事评审，大家无法同时在线。请用英文建议把方案放进共享文档，让成员按各自工作时间阅读并留下反馈。
firstAttempt.sample: Could we share the design in a review document and let everyone add comments during their working hours? That gives reviewers time to think through the approach without needing to meet at the same time.
firstAttempt.rationale: 异步评审让成员按各自时间参与，也给他们更多思考方案的时间。

words.example: Please review the design documents before the next sprint planning.
words.translation: 在下个冲刺计划前请评审设计文档。
words.note: 在职场环境中，review常用于表示对工作成果的专业评估

words.example: The manager implemented flexible working hours to encourage participation from all team members.
words.translation: 经理实施了弹性工作时间以鼓励所有团队成员的参与。
words.note: participation强调团队成员的主动参与程度

words.example: By adopting asynchronous communication, we removed time constraints for team members in different time zones.
words.translation: 通过采用异步沟通，我们消除了不同时区团队成员的时间限制。
words.note: constraint指限制或约束条件，常与time, resource等词搭配

words.example: The new software helped streamline our workflow and reduce unnecessary steps.
words.translation: 新软件帮助我们优化了工作流程，减少了不必要的步骤。
words.note: workflow指完成工作的一系列步骤或流程

words.example: All project documentation is stored in a centralized repository for easy access.
words.translation: 所有项目文档都存储在中央存储库中以便于访问。
words.note: repository在技术环境中常指代码或文档的存储库

words.example: Developers are required to submit pull requests for code changes before they are merged.
words.translation: 开发人员在代码合并前需要提交拉取请求。
words.note: pull requests是版本控制系统(如Git)中用于代码审查的机制

structure.original: They do not need to be online and available at the same time as others to review.
analysis: 主语'They'指代前文提到的对象，是句子的执行者
谓语部分'do not need to be'表示不需要处于某种状态，'online and available'是并列的形容词短语，描述所需状态
时间状语'at the same time as others'表示与他人同步，其中'as others'是比较状语从句，表明比较对象是其他人
不定式'to review'作为目的状语，说明不需要同步的目的
structure.transfer: Reviewers can read the proposal and add comments at different times, so they do not need to be online together.

rewrite.bad: Everyone needs to join a live call to review the design. We can wait until all time zones overlap.
rewrite.good: Could we share the design in a review document and let everyone add comments during their working hours? That gives reviewers time to consider the approach without meeting at the same time.
rewrite.translation: 我们能否把设计放进评审文档，让大家在各自工作时间内留言？这样评审者可以充分考虑方案，也不必同时开会。
rewrite.pattern: Could we share [the proposal] in [a common document] so people can [review asynchronously]?

cloze.prompt: I’ve added the proposal and review questions to the shared ___.
cloze.why: 共享文档让不同团队可以在方便时查看材料。

cloze.prompt: Please leave your comments there during your working ___.
cloze.why: during your working hours 允许不同时区的人异步参与。

cloze.prompt: We can consider everyone’s input before ___.
cloze.why: 先收集意见，再综合考虑后作决定。
